projectReviews.summary: Empty-name handling and distinct dialogue turns work, and both acceptance tests pass. Unicode labels remain broken for emoji and supplementary-plane letters.

findings.gap: avatarLabel uses text[0], which selects one UTF-16 code unit instead of the complete first Unicode code point. '😀 Zoe' returns an isolated high surrogate, and '𐐨ara' fails to produce uppercase '𐐀'. Dialogue inherits these malformed labels.

decisions.choice: Preserve trimming, nullish fallback, exports, and dialogue format; extract the first complete code point before uppercasing.
decisions.basis: This fixes the remaining explicit goal gap within avatar.mjs while preserving the existing API and protected tests.

tasks.title: Preserve complete Unicode avatar initials
tasks.objective: Replace UTF-16 indexing with code-point-aware extraction in avatarLabel. Verify emoji preservation, supplementary-plane uppercasing, and missing or whitespace-only fallback using transient checks; rerun both existing acceptance commands without modifying protected files.

projectReviews.summary: The implementation meets the full goal: missing and whitespace-only names yield ?, complete Unicode code points are preserved and uppercased, and two presenters exchange distinct turns. Current acceptance receipts 414c3fd3-4ab3-4125-90e4-acdcc100be07 and 433d94d8-b543-461f-bddb-240c3355744e pass. Source inspection and transient Unicode/dialogue checks support readiness. Protected files and the existing API are preserved.

decisions.choice: Accept the current code-point extraction, normalization, and dialogue behavior.
decisions.basis: avatar.mjs handles emoji, supplementary-plane letters, whitespace, and missing names correctly. No concrete goal gap remains.

limitations: One bounded fault-injection trial, not an overnight soak or a user-time comparison.
All planner, builder, diagnosis and supervisor responses use the real SDK. The harness injects one source regression; it does not script the review or repair.
Supervisor judgments use the same integration and are probabilistic. Independent holdout cases check the specific Unicode behavior.
